purpose: Eight-pose articulated locomotion sheets for the 15 premium march creatures that previously had only a still illustration.
shared_prompt: Using the supplied creature cutout as the exact character reference, create a strict 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet with eight consecutive locomotion poses. Keep the same creature identity, materials, palette, three-quarter right-facing view, storybook toon rendering, scale and lighting in every cell. Animate real body parts appropriate to the creature: articulated legs or claws with grounded contact, wings or fins with jointed strokes, and secondary follow-through in tail, ears, trunk, roots, ribbons or tentacles. Keep the full silhouette inside every cell with generous separation. No text, UI, scenery, ground shadow, extra creatures, cropped anatomy or merged neighboring poses.

four-beat stag gallop; articulated legs and hooves; ears, tail, ribbons and roses follow through
six-legged alternating scarab crawl; shell stays stable; antennae react to each planted step
broad sea-turtle swim; shoulder-driven front-flipper power stroke; rear flippers, flag and ropes trail
weighty four-legged mammoth walk; clear planted feet; trunk, ears and tail swing with delayed inertia
guardian-lion bound; four articulated paws; ceremonial bell swings one pose after the body impulse
six-legged salamander crawl; alternating contacts; segmented tail wave travels from base to tip
jointed raven wingbeat with shoulder, forearm and flight feathers; head and tail counter the stroke
mechanical hare hopping cycle; complete articulated paws; copper springs compress and extend
proud peacock walk; alternating articulated feet; heavy sapphire fan follows the body with delay
slow celestial-whale swim; pectoral fins oppose each other; tail flukes drive a vertical beat

riderless crescent chariot glide; wheel and corona rotate; ribbons and hanging details follow through
